title: 섬의 바다
description:
강줄기가 하룻밤 사이에 바뀌자, 눈에 갇힌 산골 마을에 사는 야간 근무를 하는 사서는 무엇을 남길지 결정해야 한다.

시간이 한 장소를 바꾸는 방식에 관한 조용한 소설.

title: The Harbour at Fenwick Hollow
description:
When the migrating birds leave a month early, a widowed beekeeper in an old city of canals has to decide what is worth keeping.

In thirty-one short chapters that move between past and present, it asks about small kindnesses.

title: A Map of Marrow Bay
description:
For years an apprentice clockmaker has avoided an old city of canals; then a stranger buys every copy of the same book, and everything comes back.

A quiet novel about memory and forgiveness.
